    %% UC-01 - People - table `users`
    class User{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        name : varchar(255)
        email : varchar(255)
        password : varchar(255)
        role : varchar(255)
        status : varchar(255)
        failedLoginAttempts : smallint
    }

    %% UC-02 - People - table `student_profiles`
    class StudentProfile{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        matricNo : varchar(32)
        programCode : varchar(8)
        yearOfStudy : smallint
        sectionId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% UC-02 - People - table `supervisor_profiles`
    class SupervisorProfile{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        programCode : varchar(8)
        capacityPsm1 : smallint
        capacityPsm2 : smallint
    }

    %% UC-05 - People - table `coordinator_scopes`
    class CoordinatorScope{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        program : varchar(128)
        isPrimary : boolean
    }

    %% UC-04 - People - table `sections`
    class Section{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        code : varchar(16)
        name : varchar(128)
        courseCode : varchar(16)
        lecturerId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% UC-04 - People - table `lecturer_marks`
    class LecturerMark{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        sectionId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        affective : numeric
        cognitive : numeric
        psychomotor : numeric
        enteredBy : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% UC-02 - Registration - table `student_enrolments`
    class StudentEnrolment{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        attemptNo : smallint
        status : varchar(32)
        repeatsEnrolmentId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% ---- Associations ----

    User <|-- StudentProfile : is a
    User <|-- SupervisorProfile : is a
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" StudentEnrolment : holds
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..1" Section : sits in
    User "1" --> "0..*" Section : lectures
    User "1" --> "0..*" LecturerMark : keys
    Section "1" --> "0..*" LecturerMark : records
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" LecturerMark : earns
    User "1" --> "0..*" CoordinatorScope : scoped as
    StudentEnrolment "0..1" --> "0..*" StudentEnrolment : repeats
    User "1" --> "0..*" StudentEnrolment : enrols
